data.name: Muaadhah
data.gender_notes: Muaadhah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muaadhah is derived from the Arabic root 'a-d-h' which signifies 'to return' and 'to obey'. It implies one who returns and obeys, highlighting the significance of obedience in Islam. The name Muaadhah carries the meaning “One who returns and obeys” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Muaadhah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who returns and obeys and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual name that embodies the essence of submission and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Muaadhah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who returns and obeys.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muaadhah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: معاذة
in_arabic.long_meaning: معاذة هي اسم علم مؤنث يعود إلى الجذر العربي ع ظ ح، ويحمل معاني السمو والشرف والكرامة، وقد أستخدم هذا الاسم في العصر الجاهلي والاسلامي لتحديد مكانة المرأة وشرفها، كما يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء القرآنية التي تظهر في سورة النساء

in_urdu.name: مُعاذہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُعاذہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو عظح کے gốc سے لیا گیا ہے، اس کے معنی بلوغ و شرف اور عزت ہیں، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں خواتین کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن پاک میں بھی ہے

in_hindi.name: मुआ़धाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआ़धाह एक अरबी नाम है जो अरबी जड़ से लिया गया है, इसके अर्थ सम्मान और गरिमा और गौरव हैं, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महिलाओं के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी है

in_pashto.name: مُعاذہ

Her name, which reflects her commitment and dedication to the Islamic cause and obedience to the Prophet, serves as an inspiration for Muslims to uphold these values in their daily lives.
